approach: Bergman [Be11] explicit bound as single core lemma (2^(2i)*n < 16*i^2*(i-1)*gcd^2), h n = sqrt(n)/4; full reduction proven (Vandermonde identity C(n,i)*C(n-i,j-i)=C(n,j)*C(j,i) via Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial, ES bound gcd>=C(n,i)/C(j,i) proven in N, i^2(i-1)<=4^i, Tendsto).
notes: Referee NOT run: file compiles with exactly one sorry (bergman_core). Core = analytic content of Bergman 2011 (multinomial common divisors); upstream docstring cites public Lean proof (plby/lean-proofs van Doorn) we cannot fetch offline. Numeric verification n<=160: min over pairs of gcd/(sqrt(n)/4) >= 8.0 (worst n=16,(2,6)); per-pair vs Bergman bound ratio >= 4.0; min always at i=2. Decomposition g=(C(n,i)/C(j,i))*D, D=gcd(C(j,i),C(n-i,j-i)); j=n/2 gives D~n/4; D=1 only when j<<n/2 where ratio is big. Classical fact verified: (n/gcd(n,k)) | C(n,k).
